gate.description: Sync and sanity before any work: fetch + fast-forward main; hash-diff compiled views against canonical (drift = P0, residue R3); orphan reaper — expired claims, dead worktrees, handoff-less sessions (R12); surface pending CI failures.
gate.blocks: working on stale or drifted state

gate.description: Runs the repo's fast checks on the changed surface before any task may transition to done. The fast tier has a hard latency budget — a slow check is demoted to CI, never tolerated here.
Repo's medium checks plus the structured-commit format contract. Amber: a failed medium check warns and records; the commit proceeds but the breach is logged with a deadline (CI re-asserts at red).
gate.blocks: nothing locally (amber); the breach record feeds trust scoring

gate.description: Repo's full checks. Local bypass (--no-verify) is permitted for flow but never escapes re-assessment: CI runs the same gate at red.
gate.blocks: the push (bypassable locally; never in CI)

gate.description: The incorruptible floor (R1): every gate re-asserted, contract checks executed, evidence replayed. The merge is the real door; no participant — human, agent, or hook-less runtime — routes around it.

The closeout pipeline: handoff artifact written (done / undone / commands / exit codes / blockers); next-session prompt generated then claim-verified against the repo (VERIFIED / REWRITTEN / HYPOTHESIS per claim); memory distillation gate (cap 2, five checks incl. falsifiability); claims released; worktrees removed.
